svg.title: x / y mod 97 as a table, a row for each a and a column for each b: seed 0's split at the paper's 50%, the training equations filled and the held-out ones a question mark; left, the corner a = 0 to 11, b = 1 to 11, with each c
svg.text: the corner: c = a / b mod 97
filled: an equation to train on; ?: held out
No equation is in both halves, and every one is in one; another seed draws another half.
